notes: *both … and* is one connective written in two words and belongs to the waw s022, headed on the closing *and*; the two benefactive לְs (s019, s023) are unrepresented, since a preposition is not what *both* says (rule 14).
כְּפִי fuses as *according to* under rule 30's one-rendering condition, source head on the construct noun (rule 23).
The three-level chain שַׁעֲרֵי מַחֲנוֹת יְהוָה carries no article morpheme, so both English *the*s are supplied to the two constructs (rule 29).
